text:
sam_support: FYI customer on Dedicated reported a structured-output regression immediately after the model version flip this morning. Their JSON schema validator started failing for previously-stable endpoints. I'm pasting the customer's sample response and repro below.

sam_support: customer-observed response (they pasted)
```json
{
  "user_id": "12345",
  "profile": "{\"name\":\"Alice\",\"address\":{\"street\":\"1 Main\",\"zip\":\"94105\"}}",
  "roles": ["admin"],
  "preferences": [{"key":"email_notifications","value":"true"}]
}
```
sam_support: their validator expects user_id as integer and profile.address as object; now profile was string-escaped and preferences turned into an array of objects rather than a map. They attached request_id "req_0a9b3f" and said failures started right after we rolled model tag rwd-v5-2026-03-10.

sam_support: repro steps they gave: 1) POST /v1/generate with model=rwd-v5-2026-03-10, 2) prompt uses structured output mode, schema attached, 3) observe failed validation. quick curl they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-v5-2026-03-10","mode":"json","prompt":"<their prompt>","schema":{...}}'
```

ryan_ml: thanks. can you drop the raw request_id and the raw prompt (sanitized) so we can repro locally? i want to confirm if decoder change in v5 is stringifying nested objects.

sam_support: request_id=req_0a9b3f, sanitized prompt attached in private. customer is on Dedicated (eu-west).

jordan_sre: i pulled the serving logs for req_0a9b3f. see this snippet from response marshalling: 
```
WARN marshal: non-scalar nested payload detected, coercing to string for safety (module serve/structout.go:214)
INFO transform: applied safe-escape on nested-value (policy: default)
```
jordan_sre: looks like a new safety path triggered in the runtime that stringifies nested objects when certain flags are set.

ryan_ml: that's the likely culprit. we shipped a change to the structured-output postprocessor that flips on "safe-escape" for multitype embeddings — intended for freeform generations to avoid injection, but it shouldn't run for strict schema mode.

kate_product: customer impact? how many Dedicated customers could hit this?

sam_support: this customer is the first escalated case, but we saw two similar support DMs (non-escalated) earlier from the same day. both Dedicated.

ryan_ml: immediate mitigation: revert the postprocessor behavior for model tag rwd-v5-2026-03-10 in hosted routing for Dedicated customers, or add a per-tenant override to disable safe-escape for endpoints using structured output mode. i'd prefer a targeted rollback + patch.

mira_support_lead: customer is highly sensitive (enterprise), requesting urgent rollback to previous model variant. they want ETA and repro confirmation before we roll back.

jordan_sre: can do a canary rollback to previous variant rwd-v5-2026-02-28 for this customer's tenant and run their test harness. i'll coordinate with infra.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollback for tenant tenant-8745 to model rwd-v5-2026-02-28 at 1746858600 (windows: 30m). Notifying oncall.

ryan_ml: follow-up plan: 1) patch postprocessor to respect schema-mode flag so nested objects are preserved; 2) add unit tests for nested-object passthrough; 3) run regression suite against Dedicated manifest. i'll open PR today and mark as urgent.

sam_support: customer asked for repro logs and timeline. i'll send them the canary time and offer a temporary workaround: pin model to previous variant in tenant config.

kate_product: please include a short customer-facing note explaining root cause: inadvertent safe-escape stringification during structured-output decoding post-upgrade. keep it non-technical.

ryan_ml: ack. i'll draft a fix and target patch release in next 24h if canary confirms rollback fixes it.

sam_support: great. i'll update the customer after canary completes. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

jordan_sre: after canary completes i'll post logs and a few sample responses here for confirmation.

mira_support_lead: mark as P0 ticket and escalate to account team.

sam_support: added to ticket tracker and pinged account team. closing loop here once canary confirmed. :white_check_mark:
